TOOLING BURST T4i — touch cast aims FORWARD (Run C-5; Matt 2026-09-16 bug report on the Vercel build: "All casting starts out behind the character and down.. depending on which way you end the tap on the cast button it will either cast down and left, middle or right, but never forward or up"; Matt rulings R-C5 Packet-84: no targeting protocol, CAST button stays, no tap-to-cast). task_id "T4i".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4b (G1 component + targeting rule) and T4f (pierce / labels; "no targeting; CAST button stays; ranges unchanged").
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/godot_import.py — the emitted keeper.gd (find the `_unhandled_input` handler that sets `vfx_cursor_override` on every InputEventScreenTouch, and `_cast_frame_changed` where `cursor` feeds `G1.resolve_target`), the G1 component script emission (`resolve_target`), tests/test_godot_import.py and tests/test_vfx_picker.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib only; Godot at /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot for the headless import proof.

DIAGNOSIS (state it in out/files.json notes): on a touchscreen the last InputEventScreenTouch is the tap on the on-screen CAST button (drax's web overlay, bottom of the screen), so `vfx_cursor_override` = the button's world position = behind/below the follow-camera-centred Keeper; the cast resolves toward it. Mouse users never hit this because mouse events clear the override.

BUILD (minimal, backward-compatible, in the exporter's emitted keeper.gd — never a hand edit of an exported tree): a touch-originated cast aims FORWARD — when the cast input's origin is touch (the last pointer event was an InputEventScreenTouch / InputEventScreenDrag, or `DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available()` and no mouse motion has been seen since the last touch), `cursor` = `global_position + FACING_VECTORS[facing].normalized() * float(kit.range_px) * art_scale` (the kit's full range along the facing direction; per-skill range unchanged; pierce/labels unchanged); mouse casts keep the existing cursor aim byte-for-byte. Additionally ignore ScreenTouch events whose screen position lies inside the bottom 22 % of the viewport (the overlay band) for the purpose of setting `vfx_cursor_override` — record this band as a named constant `TOUCH_OVERLAY_BAND = 0.22` so drax can align his overlay. Keep `vfx_cursor_override` as the probe hook (tests set it directly; that path must still win when it is non-null AND the input origin is not touch — define the precedence explicitly and document it in a comment).
Tests (unittest, stdlib + the existing headless harness): the emitted keeper.gd contains the forward-aim branch and the constant; a headless probe casts twice — once with a synthetic ScreenTouch at the bottom-centre of the viewport (overlay band) and once with a synthetic ScreenTouch in the world area above it — and asserts the first cast's resolved destination lies along the facing vector at range (±2 px) while the second aims at the touch; the mouse path's destination is unchanged against the frozen T4f fixture.
ACCEPTANCE (report in runs/C-5/t3/T4i/acceptance.json): the two synthetic touch casts resolve as stated; the six kits + two burst kits export byte-identically except keeper.gd; headless import exit 0; FULL suite: `cd /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — all green except the five standing reds (test_f04_outside_at_least_three; three test_named_genuine_annuli_retained subtests; test_synthetic_contract_and_grid) plus the ten headless-Godot reds your sandbox produces (environment; the conductor re-runs outside) — name every red.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/effect_kit.py, export/replay.py, any existing test except the two named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4i/. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4i/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4i"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
